fusions.name: Cracking Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a stone slug at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 13 rock damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gravel Charge
fusions.desc: Blasts a charge of jagged gravel in a cone 5 tiles ahead that deals 26 rock damage to everything in it, ignoring armour, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Firing Parapet
fusions.desc: Raises an earthen parapet 5 tiles long for 10 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Struck Flint
fusions.desc: Conjures a flintlock to fire. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 2 seconds.
